name: Data Analyzer: Saving a second program with an existing name raises an error instead of returning a fake ID
objective: Shows a failed save is never reported as a success.
precondition: Program manager and its program store created in a temporary folder; the AI parser is replaced by a canned dictionary answer (one field, 'age', type int). No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Create a program named 'Same Name', then create another with the same name.
steps.expected: The second attempt raises a save error.

name: Data Analyzer: A saved program can be loaded back by its ID
objective: Shows a returned ID corresponds to a real stored program.
precondition: Program manager and its program store created in a temporary folder; the AI parser is replaced by a canned dictionary answer (one field, 'age', type int). No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Create and save a program, then load it by its ID.
steps.expected: The stored program is found (not empty).

name: Data Analyzer: A custom program name is stored in the one save
objective: Shows the chosen name is used straight away and the program can be found by that name.
precondition: Program manager and its program store created in a temporary folder; the AI parser is replaced by a canned dictionary answer (one field, 'age', type int). No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Create a program named 'PatientIntake', then load it by that name.
steps.expected: The program's name is PatientIntake and loading by that name returns the same program ID.

name: Data Analyzer: Choosing not to save still works and stores nothing
objective: Shows the no-save option produces a result without writing to the store.
precondition: Program manager and its program store created in a temporary folder; the AI parser is replaced by a canned dictionary answer (one field, 'age', type int). No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Create a program with saving turned off, then look for it in the store.
steps.expected: Nothing is found in the store for its ID.

name: Data Analyzer: A refusal from the database is raised, not hidden
objective: Shows if the store reports failure the caller is told.
precondition: Program manager and its program store created in a temporary folder; the AI parser is replaced by a canned dictionary answer (one field, 'age', type int). No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Replace the store with a stand-in that reports 'not saved', then create a program.

name: Data Analyzer: A failed save leaves no stray program file behind
objective: Shows a rejected duplicate does not leave clutter on disk.
precondition: Program manager and its program store created in a temporary folder; the AI parser is replaced by a canned dictionary answer (one field, 'age', type int). No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Create program 'Dup', note the files in the programs folder, then try to create 'Dup' again.
steps.expected: The second attempt raises a save error and the list of files in the folder is unchanged.

name: Data Analyzer: The API reports a failed save as an error, not as a program ID
objective: Shows the web interface does not claim success when saving failed.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; the program manager is replaced by a stand-in. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Make the program manager raise a save error, then upload a tiny dictionary asking to save it as 'X'.
steps.expected: HTTP 500; the reply has no program_id; the error text contains 'could not be saved'.

name: Data Analyzer: The API sends the custom name into the single save, with no second save
objective: Shows the name is given at creation time rather than changed afterwards, which could fail silently.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; the program manager is replaced by a stand-in. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Upload a tiny dictionary asking to save it as 'Custom' with a stand-in program manager that succeeds.
steps.expected: HTTP 200; the manager was called with program_name 'Custom'; the database save routine was never called separately.
